problem: request.signal.throwIfAborted() appears twice in execute (lines 102 and 104), which can look like a duplicated guard.
why_not_a_defect: Idiomatic abort checking: once before the await and once after it, because the signal can fire while the recording is being read. The sibling native adapter does the same (src/commands/review-agents-runtime/native-adapter.ts throwIfAborted at lines 133 and 199, before and after its awaits).
